invented.quote: Every child we can't fund stays on the waiting list.
invented.why: The brief does not state that children not funded by this specific campaign will remain on the waiting list or that there are no other sources of funding for them.

invented.quote: In January, I'll write to tell you how many children started lessons because returning donors came back, whether or not you give.
invented.why: The brief says nothing about sending a follow-up report in January to all lapsed donors.
